tool_args.rationale: The target horizon is 19.2, while all pilot horizons are at most 0.48. A slow-horizon probe addresses the resulting genuine ambiguity in adaptation strength and timescale.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential model from the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five correlated short-horizon observations do not reliably identify the slow timescale or long-horizon reversal.
The pilot has s_grad fixed at zero and cannot distinguish its sink dependence; the recommended slow-horizon probe is needed first.
Additional short-timescale detail would not resolve the long-horizon extrapolation as directly.
The verified adaptation candidates and pilot signatures make long-horizon discrimination more informative than committing to a periodic model.
